headline: Discussion of the Search Institute Developmental Relationships Student Survey for grades 4-12 in Fall 2026, and future agenda topics.
summary: The meeting will discuss a student survey on developmental relationships for grades 4-12. It will also discuss possible future topics, including the School Lunch Program, Wellness Policy, and/or School Start Times.
